description: Either weak attendance or weak study effort contributes an engagement-related support signal.
Two sequential academic periods supporting low-performance concern indicate persistence across periods.
Persistent low performance is corroborated by failure history or an engagement-related concern.

A degree of support need associated with second-period concern when first-period concern is limited.
Compounded academic-support need from core risk or combined failure-history and study-time concerns.
